Package frc.lib.NinjasLib.localization.vision

Class Vision

java.lang.Object
frc.lib.NinjasLib.localization.vision.Vision
public class Vision extends Object
Top-level manager that aggregates every VisionCameraIO on the robot (any mix of LimelightVisionCameraIO, PhotonVisionCameraIO and, in simulation, PhotonVisionSimCameraIO) behind one API. Construct it once from a VisionConstants describing the cameras, register it with setInstance(Vision), call periodic() every robot loop to pull fresh pose estimates, and read results back through the getX accessors or getVisionOutputs().

If the supplied VisionConstants is incomplete, this class disables itself rather than throwing: every accessor then returns a harmless default and periodic() becomes a no-op.

    • Vision

      public Vision(VisionConstants constants)
      Builds every camera described in constants and, in simulation, a VisionSystemSim loaded with the field's AprilTags to drive them. If constants is missing its cameras, VisionConstants.fieldLayoutGetter or VisionConstants.robotPoseSupplier, vision is disabled instead of partially constructed.
      Parameters:
      constants - the cameras and shared configuration to build vision from

    • periodic

      public void periodic()
      Updates every camera and logs their outputs. Call this once per robot loop (e.g. from Robot.robotPeriodic()) - it is the sole point at which cameras are polled for new pose estimates, so every getX accessor below only reflects data as fresh as the last call to this method. In simulation, this also advances the shared VisionSystemSim using VisionConstants.robotPoseSupplier so simulated cameras see tags from the robot's actual simulated pose. No-op if vision is disabled.

    • getVisionOutputs

      public VisionOutput[] getVisionOutputs()
      Gets the full set of pose estimates produced by all cameras on the last periodic() call. A camera may contribute zero, one, or (for PhotonVision, which can have multiple unread pipeline results per loop) several entries.
      Returns:
      every VisionOutput from every camera since the last periodic() call
